# fjordrun_pricing (Data Source)

Plans and usage rates. Needs no token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fjordrun_pricing" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `plans` (Attributes List) The plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))
- `rates` (Attributes List) Usage rates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rates))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Plan code.
- `features` (List of String) Features.
- `included_usage_eur` (Number) Usage included.
- `limits` (Attributes) Limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans--limits))
- `monthly_eur` (Number) Monthly price.
- `name` (String) Name.

<a id="nestedatt--plans--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans.limits`

Read-Only:

- `build_memory_mb` (Number) Build memory.
- `function_fixed_idle_s` (Number) Fixed function idle window, if any.
- `function_free_gb_seconds` (Number) Free function GB-seconds.
- `function_free_requests` (Number) Free function requests.
- `function_max_memory_mb` (Number) Function memory.
- `function_max_replicas` (Number) Function instances.
- `function_max_timeout_s` (Number) Function timeout.
- `max_memory_mb_per_service` (Number) Memory per service.
- `max_replicas` (Number) Replicas.
- `max_vcpu_per_service` (Number) vCPU per service.
- `max_volume_gb` (Number) Volume size.
- `max_vpc_environments` (Number) Environments per private network.
- `max_vpcs` (Number) Private networks.



<a id="nestedatt--rates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rates`

Read-Only:

- `granularity` (String) Granularity.
- `meter` (String) Meter.
- `per_second_eur` (Number) Price per second.
- `price_eur` (Number) Price per unit.
- `unit_label` (String) Unit.
